privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: This page explains, in plain language, what happens to your information when you use Life Goes On. No legal boilerplate — just what we actually do.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: When you subscribe, we collect your name and email address — nothing else. We don't use tracking scripts, analytics, or advertising cookies of any kind.

why.title: Why we collect it
why.body: Your name and email are used for exactly one purpose: sending you the daily motivational message you signed up for.

share.title: Who we share it with
share.body: Two services process your data to make this work: MongoDB Atlas stores it, and Resend delivers the emails. Neither uses your information for anything beyond that.

retention.title: How long we keep it, and unsubscribing
retention.body: We keep your information for as long as you're subscribed. Clicking the unsubscribe link in any email permanently deletes your name and email from our records immediately — not just a flag that stops the emails.

localStorage.title: Local storage
localStorage.body: This site remembers your language and theme (light/dark) preference using your browser's local storage. That stays on your device, is never sent to us, and isn't used to track you.
